lanes.summary: Diff matches both tickets. PMAT-4380: 10+ build.rs producers switched from the gone ../../../provable-contracts sibling to in-tree contracts/<crate>/binding.yaml, hard-panic when contracts/ exists but the per-crate binding.yaml is missing (monorepo-only, crates.io fallback preserved), restored 8 per-repo binding.yaml registries plus aprender/binding.yaml backfill, deleted 2 dead build.rs stubs (aprender-graph, aprender-verify) plus the provable-contracts block in aprender-verify-ml, fixed aprender-serve's arch-requirements/tensor-names paths, and renamed 3 aprender-serve #[contract] sites (gemm-v1/forward-pass-v1/sampling-v1 -> matmul/rmsnorm/softmax-kernel-v1) to match rows now verified present in the restored contracts/realizar/binding.yaml. The contracts-macros hardening (#4368 registry_miss compile_error, #2699 fail-closed condition parsing, contract_env_key! parity) is additive and unit-tested with case tables. New `contract_binding_registry_is_loaded` tests assert CONTRACT_BINDING_SOURCE=binding.yaml per crate. PMAT-4581: sha2 opt-level=3 profile override is a clean, well-documented Cargo.toml addition; the cbtop M001-M003/M007/M008/M010 tests were correctly moved to crates/apr-cli/tests/falsification_cbtop_measurement.rs using CARGO_BIN_EXE_apr, and verified the source files they were removed from (aprender-core/tests/includes/falsification_measurement.rs) have no dangling Command:: or unused-import residue. verify-ml's book oracle tests now skip cleanly (with stderr reason) when python3 is absent, still asserting when present. The 'dead ALLOWED_GAPS pruned' criterion was already satisfied by a prior commit in this branch's history (not reflected as changed lines in this diff, which is expected since that commit predates this diff's base) — confirmed against the current build.rs that ALLOWED_GAPS contains only 3 not-yet-implemented ssm-kernel-v1 entries, none of which correspond to an implemented binding. No test asserts anything contrary to either ticket, no gate is weakened, and no out-of-scope work was found.
